0: risk classification of live births according to the City Program

cohort.0: The cohort consisted of all live births in 2012 registered at SINASC in the city of Joinville, SC, Brazil.

finding.0: The prevalence of neonatal near miss was 33 per thousand live births, with risk classification by the City Program, cesarean section, and public hospital being significantly associated factors.

mod_finding.0: Cesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of neonatal near miss morbidity (ORaj= 2.1; 95% CI:1.5 to 2.8).

cross-section timing.0: Data was collected for all live births in 2012.
